changes.customAnthiasImage: Own Anthias player image (x86, Pi4, Pi5) with CEC, IR, screenshot capture and self-update built in, replacing the unmaintained third-party fork
changes.migrateToMupitechImage: New "Migrate to MupiTech image" action for x86 devices
changes.officialSchedulingModel: Adopted Anthias's own simpler recurring-schedule model for content, built into each asset's editor
changes.userPrivilegeGuards: Admins can no longer edit or deactivate superadmin accounts, and no one can edit their own role/scope
changes.retroDosEasterEggs: Two new easter egg themes (retro Windows 98 style and an MS-DOS terminal look)
changes.logoRedesign: Redesigned logo with a shorter layout and a new mark
changes.standbyImageMargin: Bigger safety margin on the "no content" standby image
changes.screenshotSshRetake: Fixed being unable to capture a second screenshot over SSH after the first one
changes.deviceCardLocationOrientation: Device cards now show location and screen orientation
changes.mupitechRebrand: Rebranded to MupiTech Fleet Manager — new logo, blue color theme and Portuguese (PT) as the default language
changes.modularArchitecture: Backend reorganized into focused modules: players, groups, content, cctv, history, scheduling, locations, playlists
changes.locationsFeature: New Locations feature — organize groups and standalone devices by physical site
changes.playlistsFeature: New content Playlists — an ordered set of content that can be deployed to devices, groups or locations at once
changes.authUxImprovements: Navigation now hides menu items before login and shows a user menu with sign-out after logging in
changes.groupsNavFix: Fixed a missing "Groups" navigation link — the page always worked but had no menu entry
changes.contentLibrary: Content library with folders and type filters
changes.playbackHistory: Playback history with datetime and content filters
changes.playerScreenshots: Player screenshots with video frame capture
changes.multiLanguage: Multi-language support (EN, UK, FR, DE, PL)
changes.autoDeployUpdate: Auto-deploy via GHCR + Watchtower with update management UI
changes.cctvStreams: CCTV Streams — surveillance camera management with mosaic/rotation display modes
changes.historyFilters: History page datetime and content name filters
changes.cctvContentIntegration: CCTV streams integrated into Content page with auto-start from player schedule
changes.updateReliability: Improved auto-update reliability — update trigger no longer fails when containers restart
changes.cctvStreamFixes: CCTV stream fixes: auto-start on page open, keepalive ping, list view edit button, stable modal size
changes.reliableUpdates: Reliable update system — replaced Watchtower with docker compose-based updater, fixed stale version cache after update
changes.cctvLiveView: Live CCTV stream on player detail page — auto-refreshing snapshot with LIVE badge and keepalive
changes.cctvPolish: CCTV streams: live preview in content library, auto-restart on config change, snapshot thumbnails, player deploy with full URL
changes.friendlyUpdateUx: Friendly update UX — auto-detect version change after update and prompt page reload
changes.cctvLiveViewFix: CCTV live view fix — show live stream only when CCTV is actively running, removed manual toggle button
changes.standardPlayerCompat: Standard Anthias player compatibility — auto-detect custom features (schedule, playback control, screenshot) and hide unsupported UI elements
changes.reliableUpdateProcess: Reliable update process — removed build directive from production compose, added --no-build flag to updater
changes.cctvNowPlayingDetection: CCTV live preview now only shows when the player is actually displaying a CCTV stream, not just when a CCTV asset exists in the library
changes.emptySlotFallback: Empty schedule slots now fall back to the default slot instead of showing splash screen
changes.registerTokenAuth: Player registration endpoint secured with optional Bearer token (PLAYER_REGISTER_TOKEN)
changes.eslintSetup: ESLint 9 with TypeScript support added, moduleResolution fixed to bundler
changes.ssrfDnsFix: OG preview no longer blocks external URLs when DNS is temporarily unavailable
changes.silentExceptionLogging: Added warning logs to previously silent exception handlers (CCTV stream start, thumbnail update)
changes.forgetPlayerButton: Forget player button on player detail page — remove player from fleet manager
changes.testSuiteFix: Fixed test suite — all 28 tests pass (auth, og:image mock)
changes.cctvStreamLifecycle: CCTV stream lifecycle — ffmpeg stops on config save, restarts on preview open, stops on preview close; streams only run when needed by schedule or preview
changes.provisionPlayer: Remote provisioning — install Anthias on a fresh Raspberry Pi directly from Fleet Manager via SSH
changes.tailscaleIntegration: Tailscale VPN integration — connect to remote players via Tailscale with automatic fallback
changes.provisionFixes: Provisioning fixes — Docker group permission fix, VLC framebuffer output, viewer TTY allocation
changes.multiFileUploadFix: Fix multi-file upload — files now upload correctly and appear immediately
changes.slotLibraryFix: Fix adding content from library to schedule slot
changes.tailscaleAutoDetect: Auto-detect Tailscale VPN IP from player URL
changes.cctvSnapshotRate: CCTV stream refresh rate increased to 2 fps (every 0.5s)
changes.loginRedirectLoop: Fix login page infinite reload loop
changes.macIdentity: Player identity by MAC address — stable identification even when IP changes (DHCP)
changes.cecMonitorControl: HDMI-CEC monitor control — turn display on/off from player detail page
changes.scheduleTimelineRedesign: Schedule timeline redesign — event blocks with duration, color palette for time slots, display-off overlay
changes.slotContentModal: Slot content modal improvements — folder tabs, progress bar, duplicate check
changes.scrollOptimistic: Fix scroll jumping on slot/asset deletion (optimistic state update)
changes.tokenAuth: Token Authentication for REST API (Home Assistant integration support)
changes.hoverPreview: Hover preview on Content page (list mode) — floating popup with video/image/web preview
changes.displayOffTimeline: Fix display-off overlay on schedule timeline — now shows immediately on page load
changes.flagSwitcher: Language switcher — SVG country flags instead of text codes
changes.playbackStatsFix: Fix playback duration stats — match transcoded files by base name (video.MOV = video.mp4)
changes.rbacUsers: Role-based access control (RBAC) — admin, editor, viewer roles with user management
changes.auditLog: Audit log — track all user actions with filters and pagination
changes.remoteTerminal: Remote terminal — SSH access to players directly from the browser via WebSocket
changes.bulkProvisioning: Bulk provisioning — scan network and install Anthias on multiple Raspberry Pi at once
changes.terminalProtocolFix: Fix remote terminal — send raw ANSI text instead of JSON for proper xterm.js rendering
changes.fullAuditCoverage: Full audit log coverage — track schedule, media, deploy, CCTV, settings, CEC, and all player actions
changes.cheatsheetContainerFix: Fix terminal cheatsheet — use docker compose service names instead of hardcoded container names
changes.nginxAutoUpdate: Nginx config auto-update — WebSocket proxy config is now automatically synced on container restart
changes.terminalCheatsheet: Terminal command cheatsheet — clickable sidebar with Docker, system, network, Anthias API, and config file commands
changes.autoSshCreds: Auto-set default SSH credentials when players register via phone-home
changes.perAssetVolume: Per-asset volume control — set TV volume (0-100) and mute per schedule slot item via HDMI-CEC
changes.iconOnlyButtons: Compact icon-only action buttons on player detail page
changes.irFallbackPower: IR fallback power control — send IR power-on code when HDMI-CEC is unavailable after power loss (Samsung, LG, Sony, Panasonic, Philips + custom)
changes.pi5PlayerSupport: Raspberry Pi 5 player support — auto-detect Pi model during provisioning, separate Docker images and compose template for Pi5
changes.cctvInternetBlock: CCTV streams blocked from internet access (local/VPN only)
changes.cctvLoginRequired: CCTV page now requires authentication (replaces nginx IP block)
changes.cctvHlsPlayback: Players now stream CCTV via direct HLS video (smooth playback instead of JPEG snapshots)
changes.phonehomeMacFix: Phone-home script now sends MAC address and device info for reliable identity
changes.provisionMacDedup: Provisioning identifies players by MAC address to prevent duplicates
changes.serverTelemetry: Server telemetry dashboard — live CPU, memory, disk usage with progress bars and auto-refresh
changes.cctvGridHls: CCTV grid mode: HLS live video for RTSP cameras with automatic snapshot fallback for legacy devices
changes.cctvGridCpuFix: CCTV grid: optimized CPU — cameras scaled to cell size
changes.cctvStreamStatusFix: Fixed CCTV stream restart detection after container update
changes.irFallbackSchedule: Display power schedule: IR fallback when CEC is unavailable (cold boot / power loss)
changes.irButtonVisibility: IR Power button now visible immediately on player page load (without opening Settings)
changes.cctvEditRestart: CCTV stream auto-restarts after editing camera configuration
changes.cctvWebUrlAutoDetect: Auto-detect web URLs in CCTV config — prevents ffmpeg crash from HTTP URLs treated as RTSP
changes.cctvWebSources: CCTV grid mode: web URL sources rendered at 1920x1080 in iframe, scaled to fit grid cells
changes.cctvMosaicSimplify: Simplified mosaic editor — drag-to-swap camera positions, removed react-grid-layout dependency
changes.infiniteDuration: Infinite duration (∞) for slot items — content plays until schedule change, ideal for CCTV streams
changes.scheduleRecheck: Periodic schedule re-check every 30s during playback — new time slots take effect without waiting for current asset to finish
changes.tailscaleHostname: Tailscale provisioning now sets player name as hostname for easy identification
changes.pi5ProvisionDynamicIp: Pi5 provisioning: redis-init now detects IP dynamically instead of hardcoding, preventing stale IP after network changes
changes.fixPhonehomeAuth: Fixed phone-home script: auth header line continuation bug prevented player registration

registryMirror.title: Registry Mirror
registryMirror.description: Mirror the MupiTech player images (server/viewer/redis, all architectures) to a local Docker registry, so newly-provisioned devices on this network pull from here instead of the internet. Devices need Docker configured to trust this registry — done automatically during provisioning once enabled.
registryMirror.hostDesc: Address devices on this network can reach — usually this server's LAN IP and the published registry port (default 5050).

branding.title: Device Branding
branding.description: Images shown on your devices instead of Anthias's own branding. Applies fleet-wide — push it to a device from its detail page, or to a whole group from the groups page.
branding.themeLabel: Theme colors + splash-page translation (Anthias purple → blue, English → Portuguese)
branding.standbyDescription: Shown whenever a device has nothing scheduled. No default is bundled — upload a plain background here to replace Anthias's own.
branding.formatHint: Only SVG, PNG or JPEG files are supported
branding.standbyFormatHint: Only PNG, JPEG or GIF files are supported
branding.standbyGifHint: An animated GIF plays as-is on the device — no conversion, no extra setup.
branding.confirmDelete: Revert to the default MupiTech logo?
branding.pushHint: Uploading here only stages the images — nothing is sent to devices automatically. Push from a device's settings or from a group's actions.
branding.pushDesc: Replaces the selected images on this device. Uses SSH once — the password isn't stored.
branding.pushDescGroup: Replaces the selected images on every device in this group. The credentials below are only used as a fallback — any device with its own saved SSH credentials uses those instead.
branding.pushAllDesc: Re-applies each device's own resolved branding (its device/group/location override, or this fleet-wide default) to every already-added device. The credentials below are only used as a fallback — any device with its own saved SSH credentials uses those instead.
branding.sshUseSaved: leave blank to use the saved password
branding.sshSaveHint: Save these credentials for this device

migrateImage.title: Migrate to MupiTech image
migrateImage.desc: Moves this device onto our own Anthias image (ghcr.io/pedrom20/mupitech-player), replacing whatever it's running today. The previous docker-compose.yml is backed up as .bak before anything is written. x86 only for now.
migrateImage.confirmText: This replaces the device's docker-compose.yml and restarts its containers. The previous file is kept as a .bak.
migrateImage.migrated: Device migrated to the MupiTech image
migrateImage.updated: Device updated (already on the MupiTech image)
migrateImage.backupAvailable: A backup of the previous docker-compose.yml is available.
migrateImage.restoreConfirmText: This replaces the current docker-compose.yml with the .bak backup and restarts the containers.
migrateImage.restored: Device restored to its previous image
migrateImage.preserveContent: Try to keep the device's current content
migrateImage.preserveContentHintOn: Reads the current playlist via the device's own API before migrating, and re-creates it afterwards. Best-effort — locally-uploaded files it can't re-download are skipped.
migrateImage.preserveContentHintOff: The device will start with no content after migrating — deploy content to it again from Fleet Manager afterwards.

errors.no_host: Could not determine the device's host from its URL ({{url}}).

errors.unsupported_device_type: Migration to the MupiTech image is only supported for x86 devices right now (this device is "{{device_type}}"). Pi4/Pi5 images exist but haven't been validated on real hardware yet.
errors.unrecognized_image: Unrecognized image on this device ("{{image}}") — refusing to migrate automatically. This device needs manual inspection first.
